environment.description: Go Gin application deployed in namespace 'backend-services' with Istio 1.20 sidecar injection enabled (istio-injection=enabled label). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with a DENY action matching source namespaces not in the allow-list. Specifically, the policy uses a 'when' condition with 'source.namespace' key and 'notValues' of ['backend-services', 'istio-system']. The mesh operates in STRICT mTLS mode via a PeerAuthentication resource scoped to the namespace. The Envoy sidecar terminates all inbound connections and enforces the authorization policy before traffic reaches the application container on port 8080. Note: the /healthz endpoint is excluded from authorization via a separate ALLOW policy matching the path prefix for kubelet probes with source principal 'cluster.local/ns/kube-system/sa/kubelet'.
